data.hook: Nick Suss reflected on four joyful years covering the Titans, writing that he'll cherish the memories deeply and miss them for a long time.
data.name: Titans Beat Writer Nick Suss Announces Departure After Four Happy Years
data.summary: Suss, who has been The Tennessean's Titans beat writer since 2022, announced Sunday that tomorrow marks his last day on the job. He praised the role as some of his happiest years and encouraged fans to follow Tyler Palmateer, who will cover the team on an interim basis after previously handling high school sports. Colleagues like Paul Kuharsky shared warm tributes, while fans noted his creative coverage amid the team's 0-1 start.

data.name: SEC Releases Week 4 Kickoff Times with Texas-Tennessee Noon Clash
data.summary: The Southeastern Conference set kickoff times for its September 26 football slate, featuring high-stakes games like Texas at Tennessee at noon ET on ABC, LSU vs. Texas A&M at 6:30 p.m. CT on ABC, and Oklahoma at Georgia at 3:30 p.m. ET on ABC or ESPN. data.hook: Utah football fans lit up with joy when Joel Klatt finally put the Utes in his top 10, echoing their favorite mantra: death, taxes, and Utah football.
data.name: Joel Klatt Ranks Utah No. 10 After Strong 2-0 Start
data.summary: On his FOX Sports podcast, college football analyst Joel Klatt released his latest top 10 rankings, placing Texas at No. 1 after their comeback over Ohio State, with Ohio State at No. 2, Georgia at No. 3, and Utah rounding out the list at No. 10. Klatt praised Utah's dominant wins over Idaho (66-14) and Arkansas (43-10) under new coach Morgan Scalley, apologizing for overlooking them in preseason and highlighting QB Devon Dampier's balance and the team's physical play. While some debated USC's No. 9 spot, Utah supporters celebrated the nod as validation amid their No. 17 AP ranking, with fans repeating the 'death, taxes, and Utah football' phrase in pride.

data.hook: In his first road start, true freshman Faizon Brandon stayed cool under pressure, delivering two touchdown passes to lead Tennessee to victory.
data.name: Tennessee QB Faizon Brandon Earns Second Straight SEC Freshman of the Week
data.summary: Brandon completed 10 of 21 passes for 148 yards and two scores, plus 22 rushing yards, totaling 170 yards with no turnovers in the Volunteers' 45-24 win over Georgia Tech. This back-to-back SEC Freshman of the Week honor, presented by Allstate, follows his five-touchdown debut against Furman. The Greensboro, North Carolina native has Tennessee at 2-0, marking the 13th such award for a Vol under coach Josh Heupel.

It features a casual king on a throne, an Ohio State fan with Home Depot boxes, and a spot-on nod to coach Steve Sarkisian's abrupt 'Texas Fight!' interview cutoff. Fans raved about the Holly Rowe reference and production flair, calling it SEC Shorts' best work yet, though one Mississippi State supporter issued a playful boo warning.

data.name: Nebraska Holds No. 1 in AVCA Women's Volleyball Poll
data.summary: The latest AVCA/Taraflex Division I Women's Poll, released Monday, has Nebraska atop the rankings for another week, followed closely by unbeaten Pittsburgh at No. 2 after picking up six more first-place votes. Louisville rises to No. 3, Kentucky falls to No. 4, and SMU hits a program-best No. 5 with key top-10 wins. Other notable shifts include Texas at No. 7 after topping Wisconsin, Penn State jumping to No. 9 with three straight sweeps, and Colorado climbing six spots to No. 17 on an 8-0 start—setting up exciting matchups like Nebraska hosting No. 20 Creighton this week.

data.hook: Cam Ward stepped into his first NFL start under the bright lights, facing a Jets defense that sacked him three times and kept plays in check. It was a tough opener for the young quarterback and his new Titans team.
data.name: Titans Fall 23-10 to Jets in Cam Ward's Modest NFL Debut
data.summary: The Tennessee Titans lost their 2026 season opener 23-10 to the New York Jets, with quarterback Cam Ward completing 19 of 32 passes for 140 yards, one touchdown, and no interceptions while adding 21 rushing yards. Head coach Robert Saleh called Ward 'at the floor' of NFL quarterback demands but stressed his growth will come with stability after working with seven coordinators in seven years. Rookie linebacker Anthony Hill Jr. shone with 16 tackles and pass breakups amid broader team struggles on offense, defense, and special teams. Saleh urged patience as the Titans prepare for a tough Week 2 against the Eagles.

data.hook: Ethan Davis limped off the field after scoring touchdowns in Tennessee's first two games, his hard-earned starting role suddenly cut short by a torn ACL.
data.name: Tennessee TE Ethan Davis Out for Season with Torn ACL
data.summary: The senior tight end from Atlanta suffered the season-ending injury during the Vols' 45-24 win over Georgia Tech on Saturday, as confirmed by coach Josh Heupel on Monday. Davis had three catches for 43 yards and two scores early this season, building on 39 receptions and six touchdowns over four years. It's the fifth such injury for Tennessee in 2026, with sophomore DaSaahn Brame and transfer Trent Thomas set to step up as the 2-0 team eyes Kennesaw State next.
